build_get_activation: build a python module that uses get_activation to retrieve a SiLU activation function by name
create_GEGLU_layer: create a GEGLU gated linear unit layer with specified input and output dimensions for a diffusion model
create_SwiGLU_layer: create a SwiGLU gated linear unit layer using SiLU activation for transformer blocks
create_FP32SiLU_layer: create an FP32SiLU activation module that upcasts inputs to float32 before applying SiLU
create_LinearActivation_layer: create a LinearActivation module combining a linear projection with a configurable activation function
